FIELDS.NAME: TechFix Electronics
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Operations Manager, TechFix Electronics, Phone: (555) 123-4567, Email: john.smith@techfixelectronics.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At TechFix Electronics, we specialize in the retail sales and repair of a wide range of electronic devices, including smartphones, tablets, laptops, and desktop computers. Our operations are centered in a high-traffic commercial area, allowing us to engage directly with customers seeking both new products and repair services. Our knowledgeable staff provides expert assistance in diagnosing issues and performing repairs on a variety of electronic devices, ensuring that we meet industry standards for quality and customer satisfaction. We maintain a well-organized inventory management system to track our products and efficiently manage service requests. Additionally, we prioritize customer service, offering transparent communication regarding warranties and repair processes. We are fully compliant with local zoning, health, and safety regulations, contributing to a safe and welcoming shopping environment for our customers. The security of our operations is bolstered by an installed alarm system that is monitored around the clock, reducing the risk of theft and enhancing overall safety.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: TechFix Electronics also operates a small computer accessories online retail business named "TechGear Supplies."
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a theft incident occurred at our store resulting in a loss of $2,000 worth of electronics. The case was reported to local authorities, and the status remains pending. Additionally, on 07/28/2022, a customer slipped and fell inside the store, leading to a liability claim amounting to $2,500, which has been settled.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL rated, fire-resistant safe with a 2-hour rating and a secure electronic lock.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central monitoring with fenced perimeter security and regular patrols.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – TechFix Electronics does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its business operations. Our focus is solely on retail and repair of electronic devices, in compliance with all relevant regulations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – TechFix Electronics does not sponsor any athletic teams as part of its business operations. Our focus remains on the retail and repair of electronic devices.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not permitted to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The Operations Manager, John Smith, checks the certificates to ensure compliance.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – TechFix Electronics has not had any applicant indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or any related crimes in connection with this or any other property. Our focus is solely on providing quality retail and repair services for electronic devices.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – TechFix Electronics has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. The business maintains a good insurance standing with its previous carrier.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – TechFix Electronics does not lease employees to or from other employers, maintaining a dedicated staff for all operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – TechFix Electronics does not currently carry Workers' Compensation insurance as we do not have any employees classified under this requirement. However, we ensure compliance with applicable legal obligations regarding employee insurance coverage.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – TechFix Electronics also operates a small computer accessories online retail business named "TechGear Supplies." This venture complements our main business by enhancing our product offerings to customers.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – TechFix Electronics does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. We currently maintain only the specified policy for our operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – TechFix Electronics is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations are focused solely on the retail sales and repair of electronic devices.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – TechFix Electronics does not rent or loan equipment to others, ensuring we minimize liability exposure associated with such activities.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – TechFix Electronics has not had a foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years. The business maintains a stable financial standing and meets all its obligations.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – TechFix Electronics does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus solely on the retail and repair of electronic devices without handling such materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – TechFix Electronics does not have any known catastrophe exposure that would impact our operations or insurance coverage. We maintain compliance with safety regulations to mitigate potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – TechFix Electronics has not experienced any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our operations emphasize compliance and ethical standards, ensuring a safe and respectful environment.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – TechFix Electronics has no uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with all safety regulations.
